archive: lpmuds.net/files/lpuni_fluffos_v1.zip, recovered via Wayback Machine 2026-08-25 (original site down)
name: LPUniversity
english_description: A classic English-language LPC teaching/reference mudlib, positioned by its own lpmuds.net description as not ready for play -- a base for learning to build a lib without dealing much with the driver. What shipped is more complete than that framing suggests: a full login/registration/security/command-dispatch/help/mail/message-board/news/channel/Intermud-3 engine including a real first-boot admin-setup wizard, plus one small real starting domain (an entrance cafe with a greeter NPC and three upstairs floors). There is no combat/stats system at all. Porting it surfaced two especially wide-reaching FluffOS-compat bugs: this driver's PACKAGE_UIDS support requires get_root_uid()/get_bb_uid()/creator_file() master applies this archive never defined, and a .c-to-.lpc rename side effect left several wizard commands (update, clone, dest, clean, goto, ls, more) comparing a 2-character filename slice against the 4-character string ".lpc", breaking the update command and directory-listing/paging syntax highlighting. Also makes a real outbound Intermud-3 network connection at boot, same as imud/tmi2/skylib.
